build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build && cargo build --release -p companion-hook --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node scripts/sign.mjs src-tauri/target/release/companion-hook.exe

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-src 'none'
security.devCsp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost ws://localhost:5179; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-src 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: A small character that lives in the corner of your desktop
bundle.longDescription: Kulhi, Hexo, Glim or Billu keeps an eye on your coding agents, reminds you to take breaks, notices finished downloads and low battery, and can answer questions about your PC.
